scope: synthetic PC mathematical reference only; no target/hardware validation
authorship: GF extension by independent reference agent using only previous independently authored Python reference and canonical tickets; production numerical implementation and outputs not inspected
base_reference: existing ticket05 schedule_reference.py and tissue_reference.py; no C imports, compilation, invocation or generated expected production outputs
coefficient_policy: ZHL-16C nitrogen; compartment 1b; same frozen independently transcribed tissue tables as ticket05
set_pair_policy: At unchanged timestamp/tissues/pressure/max depth, recalculate using retained anchor and low-depth input. Normal planning may grow the persistent maximum first-stop ambient anchor; never reset it due to pair or recording changes. No exposure segment is added.
endpoint_formula: max(0,10*(max_i((N2_i-GF*a_i)/(1+GF*(1/b_i-1)))-surface_bar)) for the same current tissue vector; each active endpoint is treated as fixed GF
endpoint_availability: Independent numeric fixtures provide valid-tissue mathematical endpoint expectations. Public uninitialized/invalid/unknown-exposure endpoint validity is exact and requires dedicated contract tests; schedule unavailability alone does not erase known tissue mathematics.
endpoint_tolerance_justification: Ceiling derivative to a tissue pressure is 10/(1+GF*(1/b-1)) <=10 m/bar since all b<1 and GF>0. Inherited tissue bound 0.0005 bar therefore contributes <=0.005m; 0.001m extra covers floating pressure/coefficient arithmetic. This applies to direct analytical fixed-GF endpoints, not legacy 0.01bar binary search quantization. Display rounding is tested separately.
retained_policy: NDL buckets, each mandatory-stop quantum and validity remain exact. Only total TTS uses the explicit existing user-approved absolute 3s allowance. Legacy 30/70 evidence remains separately identified and unchanged.
outcome_rule: Publish all differences and fail on any field outside its declared bound. Never regenerate fixtures from production or widen tolerance after comparison.
